Subject: SOC 2 evidence request: training roster + background check samples

Hi Vivek / Monica,

We're preparing the BrightBank SOC 2 evidence bundle and need a small sample set of employee onboarding artifacts from Redwood for the period Sep 2025 - Jan 2026. Specifically: 

- A training roster/export showing completion status for mandatory security training (new hire + annual refresh).
- Redacted background-check certificates for a random sample of 25 new joiners and 10 leavers (redaction must remove PII per your redaction policy).
- A deprovisioning log showing account removals (user, date, owner) for the same leaver sample.

Can you confirm:
1) Whether you can provide these 35 redacted BG PDFs with a separate mapping document that lists original IDs (internal only) and redaction tags?
2) Preferred delivery method (SFTP, presigned S3, or secure Drive link) and any encryption/retention requirements?
3) Target turnaround: two business days from acceptance of scope — possible?

Please include any attestation HR will sign confirming the redaction and chain-of-custody. If anything above is unclear I can clarify the exact fields the auditor will want.

Thanks,
Audra
